jobs.k1_tips: tall vertical picture: a plain room. The main character sits on the floor, overwhelmed and startled, eyes wide, ears pressed back, one paw half raised, while a shower of many small plain blank paper notes and blank sticky notes falls on it from above, about twelve separate notes tumbling through the air apart from each other, two of them already resting on its head; right in front of it on the floor stands one low plain table with three dirty mugs with brown coffee rings, untouched. The flame on the tip of its tail is small and dim. LAYOUT: the main character is big and whole in the middle, filling most of the height from the floor to two thirds up; the falling notes are spread in the upper third and around the head, each note separate with clear gaps; the low table with the three mugs is in the lower right, apart from the character; the whole picture is softly coloured with watercolour; no letters or numbers anywhere.
jobs.k2_videos: tall vertical picture: a cosy plain living room in the evening. The main character lies on its belly on a soft sofa with one open laptop in front of it, chin on its paws, staring at the blank glowing screen with glazed sleepy eyes; above the sofa float about eight small blank video windows, each a plain rounded rectangle with only a small play triangle in the middle. In the foreground stands one plain coffee table crowded with nine dirty mugs with brown coffee rings, some stacked. The flame on the tip of its tail is a tiny dim ember. LAYOUT: the character and sofa are in the middle, whole; the floating video windows in the upper part; the table full of mugs fills the lower part, big and clear; the whole picture is softly coloured with watercolour; no letters or numbers anywhere.
jobs.k3_plan: tall vertical picture: a small bright kitchen in the morning. The main character stands on a small stool at the counter, pressing the switch of one electric kettle with one paw, a calm determined small smile, and looks at one dirty mug standing a little further along the counter; a hand-drawn dashed curved arrow goes from the kettle to the mug through the air. The flame on the tip of its tail burns steady and bright. LAYOUT: the main character is big and whole in the left and middle; the kettle near its paw; the mug in the right part with clear space; the arrow above them; plain walls; the whole picture is softly coloured with watercolour; no letters or numbers anywhere.
jobs.k4_table: tall vertical picture: a bright cosy kitchen in sunlight. The main character sits proudly on a wooden chair next to a completely clean, empty, shining wooden table, holding one clean white mug up in one paw, chin up, eyes happily half closed, a big proud smile; beside the table a plain dish rack holds six clean mugs in a row; a few small sparkles shine on the clean table top. The flame on the tip of its tail burns big, golden and bright with tiny sparks. LAYOUT: the main character and the table are whole, large, in the middle and lower part; the dish rack on the right; plain wall; the whole picture is softly coloured with watercolour; no letters or numbers anywhere.
jobs.k5_book: tall vertical picture: a cosy plain room. The main character sits on the floor holding open one huge thick book in both front paws; dozens of plain blank paper bookmarks and blank sticky notes stick out of the book on every side and a few more float up out of it into the air; the character looks at them with a dizzy, overwhelmed face, wide confused eyes. The flame on the tip of its tail is small. LAYOUT: the main character and the book are big and whole in the middle; the floating notes above in clear space; the whole picture is softly coloured with watercolour; no letters or numbers anywhere.
jobs.k6_together: tall vertical picture: a small cosy kitchen. The main character stands on a small stool at the sink next to the edge of the picture, warmly smiling and nodding, holding one clean dish towel ready; from the other side one human hand in a plain sleeve reaches in and rinses one mug under the running tap, so they wash it together. The flame on the tip of its tail burns steady and bright. LAYOUT: the main character is big and whole in the left and middle; the sink, tap, mug and the hand on the right; the whole picture is softly coloured with watercolour; no letters or numbers anywhere.
